title: TriggerDeadLetterPage
description: RFC 0232 §B — one page of a trigger subscription's dead-lettered deliveries, the answer to `listTriggerDeadLetters`. A dead-lettered delivery started no run, so it is on no run's log; this read is where the host's content-free record of it is visible (`trigger-bridge.md` §C).

deliveries.description: Dead-lettered deliveries, newest first. Empty when the subscription has none within `retentionDays`.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor; absent on the last page. A cursor minted for another subscription MUST be refused `400 validation_error`.

deadLetteredTriggerDelivery.description: RFC 0232 §C — one dead-lettered trigger delivery. **Content-free:** no inbound body, no inbound headers, no signature, no signing secret, no credential. A record names a delivery; it never carries what was delivered.

subscriptionId.description: The trigger subscription. Equals the path segment.

attemptEventId.description: The id of the dead-lettered `trigger.delivery.attempted`. Where the host also shows that event (a test seam), this is its `eventId`.

attempt.description: The dead-lettered attempt: the fields of the `trigger.delivery.attempted` payload for this delivery, and no others. Where the host also shows the event, the two MUST agree.

stateChange.description: The `trigger.subscription.state.changed` payload this dead-lettering caused, when it caused one. Absent for a delivery refused by verification, which MUST NOT change the subscription's state.

reason.description: Why the delivery was dead-lettered. `verification_failed`: a `required` verification check refused it. `retries_exhausted`: the retry policy ran out.

deadLetteredAt.description: When the host dead-lettered the delivery.

expiresAt.description: When this record ages out. `expiresAt − deadLetteredAt` matches `triggerBridge.deadLetter.retentionDays`.
